info.title: HeadRush Flex Prime Local Reflection API
info.description: Unofficial documentation generated from the Remote Editor bundle and live /api/v1/subtree metadata. The device exposes no native OpenAPI document. PUT and object-method POST operations can change device state.

license.name: Unofficial documentation; underlying HeadRush API is proprietary

tags.name: Reflection
tags.description: Discover object metadata and current values recursively.

tags.name: Object metadata
tags.description: JSON-Schema-like metadata for individual reflected objects.

tags.name: Object properties
tags.description: Read or update properties on individual reflected objects.

tags.name: Object methods
tags.description: Invoke reflected methods. Calls may change device state.

tags.name: Assets
tags.description: Static assets used by the Remote Editor.

tags.name: File browser
tags.description: Undocumented public directory-listing and file-download routes.

get.summary: Fetch the Remote Editor HTML shell
Fetch the Remote Editor web manifest
List a static directory or download a static file
List a client directory or download a client file
get.description: Undocumented public file router. Only client `Evil` and root path `Web` were discovered.

get.summary: List the confirmed public Evil/Web file root

post.summary: Pair or authenticate the web editor with the device

get.summary: Return metadata and current values for the complete object tree
